indicators.flag:
Promises of high or guaranteed investment or donation returns for payments made to
accounts with which you have no prior business relationship.
indicators.red_flag: Promises of high or guaranteed returns on payments to accounts with no prior business relationship
indicators.rationale: Outbound payments to counterparties with no prior business relationship are visible in core account/transaction data, but a mid-size bank does not flag them on a 'guaranteed-returns' scam pattern.

build_logic.logic: Flag outbound payments to a counterparty with which the account holder has no prior bidirectional transaction history, weighting first-ever payees and recently-opened destination accounts.
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → no-prior-relationship payment review gate

indicators.flag:
Communications, including social media posts, soliciting payments with misspellings
or messages out of profile for the counterparty, soliciting payments from individuals or
organizations with whom you have no prior existing business relationship, including
celebrities or public figures.
indicators.red_flag: Social media payment solicitations with misspellings or out-of-profile messaging, from counterparties (including celebrities or public figures) with no prior business relationship
indicators.rationale: Detecting misspelled or out-of-profile social-media solicitations requires an external social-content and linguistic-anomaly corpus the bank does not hold.

indicators.flag:
Solicitations requesting donations via social media where the solicitor is not affiliated with a
reputable organization.
indicators.red_flag: Social media donation solicitations from a solicitor not affiliated with a reputable organization
indicators.rationale: Verifying a solicitor's affiliation with a reputable organization needs an external charity/org registry and adverse-media corpus outside core banking data.

indicators.flag:
Social media posts that solicit donations or advertise give-aways that appear from accounts
that are not “verified” through the social media platform account verification processes or that
misspell the celebrity or financial institution’s name.
indicators.red_flag: Donation or give-away posts from unverified social media accounts or accounts misspelling the celebrity or financial institution name
indicators.rationale: Linking a payment to an unverified or name-misspelling social account is partly serviceable via a scam-domain/handle feed but needs enrichment beyond core data.

indicators.flag:
Multiple social media accounts communicating the same message soliciting funds for an
unknown purpose or to an unknown account.
indicators.red_flag: Multiple social media accounts pushing the same fund-solicitation message for an unknown purpose or unknown account
indicators.rationale: The bank can partly see fan-in — many originators paying one destination — in transaction data, and can enhance the existing rule rather than build new.

build_logic.logic: Detect a single destination account receiving a high volume of payments in a short window from many previously-unaffiliated originators, mirroring the alert's coordinated-solicitation fan-in.
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert → coordinated fan-in review gate

indicators.flag:
Communications, including social media posts, that provide the same CVC address across
multiple celebrity or prominent financial institution social media accounts.
indicators.red_flag: Same CVC address reused across multiple celebrity or prominent financial institution social media accounts
indicators.rationale: Correlating a shared CVC address across solicitations needs crypto chain-analytics / VASP exposure enrichment on top of any transaction record.
